warnings: THIS SHEET IS THE TARGET OF THE ก AND ข SECTION ARROWS drawn on A-04, A-05 and A-05's roof plan. Both callouts resolve here, so no dangling section reference remains in the set - unlike the แบบขยายรูปตัด ค leader on A-07, which resolves nowhere (flagged on that file).

SAME FIVE LEVELS AND THE SAME 2.55/3.10/3.40/0.60 CHAIN AS A-06 AND A-07, closing on +9.65 again. Three architectural sheets now agree on the ridge level against S-02's +10.00 note; see A-06's warning for the reading taken.
ROOF PITCH 35 DEGREES, printed on both sections.

*** ALL FOUR ROOF ENLARGEMENTS ARE CALLED OUT FROM THIS ONE SECTION, AND ALL FOUR RESOLVE. *** แบบขยายหลังคา 1 and 2 are on A-06, 3 and 4 are on A-07. Crossed both ways: every enlargement drawn on A-06/A-07 is called out from here, and every callout here lands on a drawn enlargement. That closes the §7-checklist item 5 check for the roof details - the only unresolved callout left in the set is A-07's แบบขยายรูปตัด ค.

THE y CHAIN MATCHES THE MASTER AND IS DRAWN IN THE SAME DIRECTION AS รูปด้าน 4: 1.60 + 3.00 + 4.00 under 8.60, then 2.80 + 1.00 eave, bubbles running from the bottom line up. That is now the fourth independent reproduction of 8.60 and 2.80.

ชานพัก IS PRINTED AS A BARE 2.49 with no plus sign, unlike every other level on the sheet. Recorded as level_m 2.49 - a mid-flight landing between +0.60 and +4.00 is physically right - and flagged, because the missing sign is the only thing separating it from being a dimension rather than a level. A-09/A-10 (แบบขยายบันได) are the sheets that settle it.
The stair is cut in full here, which is why this section carries the only landing level in the set; the plans mark only ขึ้น and ลง.

OPENING VOCABULARY RESOLVED ON A-14/A-15 (หน้า15, หน้า16). This file records no ป/น marks because the glyphs are unreadable at this scan's resolution. The schedules give the full closed list - eight door types ป1-ป8 and nine window types น1-น9, seventeen marks - so any later pass adding positions to this sheet has a fixed vocabulary to match against and cannot invent a mark. What is still missing is only WHICH type sits in WHICH opening on this drawing.
